name: large_request
description: Large prompt payload to measure spooling, parsing and throughput

messages.content: You are a senior system architect evaluating high-throughput distributed architectures, memory consistency models, consensus algorithms including Paxos and Raft, network partitioning guarantees under the CAP theorem, distributed transactions using two-phase commit, vector clock tracking for causal ordering, and stream processing with exactly-once delivery guarantees.

Provide an in-depth technical analysis comparing Raft leader election with Paxos synod consensus when running in geo-replicated data centers with cross-region network latency and intermittent link flapping. Detail how log compaction, snapshot replication, and membership changes are handled under both protocols, and provide concrete trade-offs for latency, availability, and failure recovery times.
